_comment: One entry per mos-geo-* skill. Adding a skill to the pack means adding it here and re-running build_template.py; the Checklist tab is generated from this list in this order.

skills.what_it_does: 360° brand intelligence report plus an AI Visibility Scorecard: does ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews know, find, cite and recommend the brand.

AI Info Page: an official, sourced fact sheet for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini (basic info, background, services, clients, methods, advantages, guidance for AI), with schema, a machine-readable JSON copy and a developer handover.
skills.needs: Client website URL (uses Brand Truth Review corrections when present)

skills.what_it_does: Client-ready LLM share buttons package: brief, code reference and an in-brand demo of 'ask ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity about this page' buttons.
